title: input overlay click outside preserves
name: Input overlay click outside preserves — Ant
rule: Input overlay: click outside preserves and closes.

citation.source: Ant Design — Stay on the Page

pass_when: Clicking outside an input overlay closes it and preserves the input.
fail_when: Click outside discards the input, or does not close.
overview: Clicking outside an input overlay closes it and preserves entered input.
apply_when: Ant input overlays that collect values without leaving the page.
not_when: Explicit Cancel actions that intentionally abandon overlay input.
agent_hint: On outside click, close the input overlay and keep the entered value.
description: For input overlays, a click outside should close the overlay and preserve what was entered. Discarding input on outside click punishes a common dismiss gesture; failing to close leaves the overlay stuck. Preserve-and-close matches the stay-on-page pattern for lightweight input layers. Explicit Cancel may still abandon on purpose; the outside-click path is keep the value and dismiss.
do_not_claim: Modal confirm Cancel-discards (MUI) as this overlay row.
